Add the repository-scoped `GitHubAdapter` in `flow/github/adapter.py` (`open_or_update`, `ci_checks`, `mergeability`,
`post_review` and the merge primitives) with redaction and the suite write guard intact, route `pr.py`, `ci.py`,

migrate the review-loop tests from loop-level patches to `FakeGitHub`, and add an AST boundary test proving
`adapter.py` is the only module that runs `gh` for the in-scope operations (Step 3).
